DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RangerHood_0: Lightweight and breathable, cut to hug the head and protect from the elements.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Rapier_0001: A slender but sharp blade crafted with a protective hand guard. Effective at both cutting and thrusting.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Rapier_8001: The chill of winter flows in the wake of this icy blade. Gifted from the Winter Fae who wanted to prove there is nothing stronger than the cold bite of their domain.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RatPendant_3: Adapt and utilize your surroundings more effectively, just like the clever rat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RawhideGlove: Buttery soft lambskin leather, toasty warm all while leaving no fingerprints behind.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RecurveBow_0: Crafted with bends, striking a balance between speed and accuracy, capable of dispatching enemies from afar.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RecurveBow_8: Capable of spreading poison that will have it’s victims begging for death, this cursed bow once belonged to first of the legendary Four Horseman.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RedApple: A fresh red apple with a vibrant hue. It looks sweet.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RegalGambeso: Beautifully dyed quilting wool with smooth leather straps ensuring a good fit.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RegalMitre_0: A mitre reserved for the highest clergy. Dyed deep crimson leather and long decorative bands at its sides reveal the wearer’s supreme authority and sacred presence.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ReinforcedGl: Made with thick yet flexible hide. Adjustable wrist bracing offering extra support and reinforcement.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Reins: Crude reins cut from rope. Easy to obtain, but vulnerable to moisture and unsuitable for long use.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RingOfCourag: Imbued with the essence of bravery, enhancing your strength.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RingOfFiness: Enhancing your ability to execute maneuvers with more ease.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RingOfQuickn: Subtly increases your movements to be more swift and fluid.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RingOfResolv: Empowering you to remain resolute and focused.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RingOfSurviv: Adapt and thrive in various environments.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RingOfVitali: Pulsing with life force, subtly enhances your vigor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RingOfWisdom: Enabling the knowledge of more complex spell casting.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RitualRobe_0: This robe, designed for the guardians of nature, is made from organic materials.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RivetedGlove: Gloves lined with the softest mink fur, reinforced leather with wrist bracing to ensure a steady grip.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RobeofDarkne: An oracle robe crafted using enchanted materials tainted with darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RodOfRighteo: Designed for functionality, the silver integration in this mace subtly improves its performance against undead beings.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RogueCowl_00: Crafted with dark fabrics helping you blend into your environment with ease.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RondelDagger: An elegant weapon with one of the sharpest points that can pierce even the most sturdy armor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RottenFluids: A viscous fluid extracted from rotting matter, emitting a sickening odor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RottenLump: A chunk of flesh torn from the body of an Abomination. Pus and rotting matter are tangled together, leaving its shape barely intact.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RoundShield_: A medium sized round wooden shield with leather accents, versatile and impactful in the users hand.
Crafted using spirit wood by a powerful ancient Druid who received permission from the forest Dryads to imbue it with the power of nature.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverAd: High-end adventurer's leather boots coated with Ruby​silver.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverBa: The helm forged from a single plate of Rubysilver, showing off the craftsman skills.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverDo: Light and breathable clothing made of two layers of Rubysilver fabric.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverFi: A high-quality cuirass made with a large amount of Rubysilver ingots. It has considerable durability.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverHa: A halberd forged from refined rubysilver ingots. Its fiercely honed crimson blade never loses its original hue, no matter how much blood stains it.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverHe: Sophisticated hand armor crafted from Rubysilver steel plate.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverHo: A hood cut from red fabric made with Rubysilver.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverIn: A highly enriched ingot of pure Rubysilver.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverLe: A cap that is further strengthened by boiling thick leather with Rubysilver dye.
Rubysilver coated leather leggings with specially reinforced knee pads.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverMy: A gorgeous robe that adds mystery to the beautiful red glow of Rubysilver.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverOr: A dirty chunk of rock containing traces of rubysilver.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverPl: Plate boots forged in Ruby​silver that provide complete toe protection.
Leggings made of ruby​silver steel. It doesn't break easily.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverPo: Powder made by finely grinding ruby​​silver ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RubysilverRa: Gloves woven from sheepskin dyed with Rubysilver dye. More durable.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RuggedBoots_: Crafted with thick leather and lined with warm compact fur.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RunestoneGlo: Smooth runes on these gloves create a subtle, yet captivating style.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RusticTunic_: A tunic made from coarse fabric. Though without adornments, it is practical and often worn by farmers and travelers in daily life.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_RustyBrokenS: A worn and broken sword, its rusted hilt and fractured blade tell tales of battles long past.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Saddle: A leather saddle long left to fade with time. Though its color has worn away, the delicate engravings suggest it once belonged to a noble or a knight.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SailorsJourn: The paper is wrinkled as if it had been soaked and dried, but the contents remain legible. It's filled with rumors about sea routes and notes from various sailors.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Sallet_0001: Crafted with a distinctive curved design, providing excellent head coverage without hindering vision or mobility.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Saltvine_100: A pale green marine plant that grows only near the Blue Maelstrom. It is a staple food for the Reeflings, but its high salinity makes it difficult for humans to consume. The Tidewalkers also use it as medicine or in rituals.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Scabbard: A scabbard used to store a sword. It protects the blade and allows for safe carrying.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ScaledArmor_: Crafted with overlapping metal scales, it provides exceptional defense without compromising mobility, ideal for agile warriors seeking both protection and flexibility.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ScrollofFade: A scroll bound with tarnished silver thread. Its outer surface is clean, but within, the text appears deliberately obscured, as if ink had been spilled to hide what once was written. Flakes of old ink litter the parchment, leaving it stained and unclean.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ScrollofForg: Though countless years have passed, the scroll remains perfectly preserved, its form untouched by time. A strange chill creeps over the one who holds it, as if the past itself were still watching.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ScrollofLost: A scroll that once bore the names of many. Most of the ink has faded beyond recognition. Faint traces remain, lines drawn through where the names once were, as if to erase them from the world.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ScrollofSeal: A scroll inscribed with dark crimson script that shimmers with an unnatural glow. Upon closer inspection, it becomes clear the writing is not ink, but dried blood. At times, while gazing upon the faded text, faint whispers can be heard with no clear source.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ScrollofVani: A scroll worn thin by the passage of time. Its parchment is cracked and brittle in many places, as if the slightest touch might tear it apart.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SealedLetter: An unnamed letter, sealed with wax. Its contents remain hidden within.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Seashell: The remains of a dead clam. If you're lucky, you might find a pearl inside its shell.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SeaweedNeckl: An ornament worn around the neck by a Tidewalker. Woven from various types of seaweed with intricate care, the necklace carries a faint shamanic aura.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Shackles: An old set of shackles. The surface is rough and corroded with age.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ShadowHood_0: A hood worn by those who hide in the shadows.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ShadowMask_0: A mask that can make you look like a villain.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SharpSeaUrch: A spine taken from a sea urchin. Thin yet remarkably sharp, it can pierce even tough leather.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ShiningPearl: A rare pearl found in giant clams. Unlike ordinary pearls, it emits its own light, illuminating the dark depths of the sea.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ShipsWheel: A steering wheel used to guide a ship’s course. Its handles are worn smooth, bearing the marks of countless voyages.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ShoesofDarkn: Crafted with rare fabric, carrying the complex patina of darkness and power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ShortSwordOf: A compact weapon, enhanced with a touch of silver, offering a small but significant edge in clashes with the undead.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ShortSword_0: A short and broad blade melded to a fine point with a round pommel at it's base.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SilverChalic: A nice wine would be the perfect accomplice.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SilverCoin_2: A silver coin, slightly tarnished but still holds some value.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SilverIngots: A highly enriched ingot of pure silver.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SilverOres_5: A dirty chunk of rock containing traces of shimmering silver.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SilverPowder: Powder made by finely grinding silver ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SilverSkullt: A skull token forged of timeless silver, stained by tales of adventures long past.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SkinnyFinger: A finger withered to the point where no flesh remains. At its tip, a sharp nail has grown long and jagged.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SkullKey_700: A mysterious key with an ominous skull embedded in it's core.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SleekHidePan: Crafted from thin yet sturdy leather, their surface has been treated with oils to achieve a faint, glossy sheen.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SlingStone_2: A small, hard stone that has been smoothed into a rounded shape.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Sling_0001: A weapon that hurls stones from a small pouch strung between leather cords. Simple in design, yet difficult to master without skill.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SmellyVomit: It is the vomit of an Abomination, reeking more foully than the rotted entrails of a long-dead beast.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SmokyPoisonP: A green powder scattered from the wings of a Demon Fly. Infused with potent toxicity, its fine particles spread easily through the air.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Soap: Made from animal fat and ash. It doesn't smell pleasant, but it still gets the job done.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SoulHeart_70: Glowing blue soul heart of a fallen adventurer.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SoulTorq_300: A beautiful solid silver necklace with an enchanting turquoise stone.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SovereignsGh: Its translucent blade dances with the shadows of fallen warriors, each strike evoking memories of its former glory and the commanding presence of its previous owner.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Spangenhelm_: Features a distinctive construction of overlapping metal plates for enhanced protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Spear_0001: Constructed by melding a piercing metal tip to a strong wooden pole, giving it a long deadly reach.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Spear_8001: Embodying the unfulfilled desires of the Fallen King of the Sea, the sharp tip of this spear constantly drips with the frigid waters of the deep abyss.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpearofRot_5: Spear imbued with the rotting essence of the fallen, carrying the stench of decay.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpectralBlad: A newly forged blade crafted upon the hilt of a loyal guardian’s sword. A cold aura shimmers along the center of the blade, and it is said that those who wield it for long begin to hear faint, unknown whispers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpectralCloa: A cloak woven from the hem of a Spectral Knight’s garment and fabric imbued with magic. The torn parts return to their original state no matter how many times they are patched, making repairs impossible. Though it appears worn, a cold magical energy flows along the cloak’s weave.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpectralCoin: This isn't your typical bag. The inclusion of spectral fabric, a rare material that straddles both realms, gives it a capacity that defies mortal understanding.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpectralFabr: This fabric shimmers with an ethereal sheen, holding the chill of the netherworld within its threads.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpectralHilt: Once wielded by a guardian whose allegiance transcended mortality, this hilt resonates with echoes of undying loyalty. Its cold touch is a solemn reminder of a pact sealed beyond the veil of death.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Spellbook_00: Crafted from engraved leather bindings and pages etched with magical ancient runes and markings.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Spellbook_80: A rare spellbook pulsing with arcane energy, whispering ancient secrets in an unknown language. Rumored to have been taken from a mysterious land only accessible through special portals.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Spellplunder: The final project of a sorcerer who vanished under mysterious circumstances. Imbued with forbidden magic, it not only steals spells but also echoes with the anguish of those whose magic it has seized, a grim companion thirsting for arcane power.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpentCandle: A candle with a short wick and hardened wax clinging to its sides. It still looks usable, but barely.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SpikedGauntl: A heavy metal gauntlet lined with sharp spikes, intimidating enough to make onlookers flinch. The spikes running from the back of the hand to the forearm are not mere decoration, but meant to deal real damage in combat. As much a weapon as it is armor, this gauntlet must be worn with care. A single misstep can injure the wearer just as easily as the enemy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SplendidCloa: A splendid cloak tinged with red that seemed to move at any moment.

DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SquareCushio: A well-used square cushion. With some fresh stuffing, it might still be usable.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StaffOfRight: A well-crafted staff, its balanced weight and sturdy construction make it a reliable companion for any encounter.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StaffofGlutt: Forged from the antlers of a wendigo, this staff devours the life force of those it touches, hungering eternally for more.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Starfish: A marine creature that inhabits the sea. Commonly found in shallow coastal waters, among reefs, or along sandy seabeds.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StefanBeret_: A decorative hat for a bard’s performance. Embellished with embroidery and feathers, it radiates an old-fashioned elegance as its rich folds cascade gracefully to the back.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SterlingAxe_: A two-handed axe forged of silver, powerful against undead foes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SterlingBlad: A two-handed blade melded with sterling silver, used to combat the undead.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SterlingBow_: A sturdy bow made of sterling silver, deftly piercing undead foes.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SterlingDagg: A sharp dagger intricately forged with silver, shaped to puncture undead enemies.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SterlingRod_: A compact mace made of sterling silver, designed for undead slaying.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SterlingShor: A solid silver short sword, crafted to swiftly eliminate undead.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SterlingStaf: A staff fused with sterling silver, melded to combat the undead. A silent threat to any undead that dare approach.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StickyTongue: A tongue cut from the slobber-soaked maw of a Cerberus. Its damp, slippery texture evokes a strong sense of disgust.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StilettoDagg: A slim and subtle assassination weapon with a thick, sturdy hilt that allows for masterful combat techniques.
Thou love me, thou love me not... Thou love me, thou love me not...
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StillmendBoo: Crafted from the hide of the mythical Earthwalker, these boots carry the creature's regenerative magic. They mend wounds with the stillness of ancient magic, restoring vitality with each rooted pause.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Stirrups: A stirrup simply made from rope and an iron ring. Light in weight yet flimsy, lacking in sturdiness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StitchedTurn: Designed with superior flexibility and comfort, allowing for swift and agile movements on any terrain.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StoneFragmen: A small piece that broke off from a larger, shattered stone.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StoneMortar: A compact stone mortar used to grind herbs, minerals, and other materials into fine powder.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StrawHat_000: A straw hat that a certain farmer often wore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StuddedLeath: Armor with a network of metal studs meticulously embedded into supple leather, offering reliable defense without sacrificing mobility or comfort.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_StuddedWyver: Expertly stitched together using a frost-encrusted hide combined with rare pelts for extra comfort.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SturdyBoots_: Boots made of thick leather. Though coarse in appearance, their durability keeps them from wearing out easily.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SturdyCloth: A tightly woven fabric made with thick thread. Its sturdy texture makes it suitable for various uses.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SturdyLog: A large high quality log cut from a tree.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SturdyRope: A thick rope tightly woven from coarse fibers. Strong and durable, it won’t break easily.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SunburstOrb_: Originally crafted to aid the Light Bringers in their sacred mission, this orb exposes those who slither in the shadows, preventing them from finding sanctuary in darkness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SurgicalKit_: A medical kit used to dress serious wounds.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_SurvivalBow_: This fast and lightweight wooden bow was improvised by adventurers for survival.
A bow made by the elves by forging the branches of the tree of truth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TailOfCentau: A wicked extension from a centaur demon that is treasured.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Tanglethread: Crafted by a renowned tailor, commissioned by beings of both shadow and light, these trousers rank among his most coveted creations. Highly prized by collectors and adventurers alike, they feature a unique thread pattern—his signature, marking the work of a tailor with unparalleled skill.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Tar: A thick, black, sticky liquid. A staple for sailors, it is used to waterproof and repair ships. Highly flammable, it must be handled with care.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TatteredChok: A crude choker made by tying together scraps of leather and worn bandages. There is no sign of proper tailoring, and its shape is rough and awkward. It barely deserves to be called a choker, yet it holds a faint but undeniable magical presence.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TatteredCloa: A cloak worn out after many adventures, but familiar to the body.

DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Telescope: A folding telescope made of metal. Easy to carry and commonly used by sailors.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TemplarArmor: A brilliant blend of plate and cloth armor, helping to protect against physical and magic attacks.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ThickForefoo: A forefoot lined with rock-hard muscle and menacing claws. Its sheer weight can be felt just by holding it.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ThornShield_: Forged in the heart of a cursed thicket where the blood of a fallen hero was spilled, this shield harbors his vengeful spirit, eager to right ancient wrongs with every calculated parry.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ThrowingKnif: Meticulously crafted sharp knives that can be thrown from a distance and pierce through even plate armor.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalArcaneG: Gloves crafted with added essence of Tidestone. They enhance the wearer’s spell power but are vulnerable to heat and can be easily damaged by fire.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalButtone: Boots distinguished by finely crafted Tidestone buttons. They wrap the ankles firmly, highlighting a sleek and stylish line.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalCloak_5: This cloak woven with Tidestone powder bears subtle wave-like patterns. Underwater it moves with the flow and does not hinder the wearer’s movements.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalCoif_50: A coif woven with powdered Tidestone. It bears a soft teal hue, allowing the wearer to retain clarity even in the depths of the sea.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalCrystal: A crystal orb refined from Tidestone. When used the orb swirls with wave-like currents of energy enhancing the caster’s focus.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalElkwood: A crown of sturdy leather infused with the spirit of the sea. Its delicate Tidestone horn adornments shine with a blue, watery light.
Vambraces reinforced with rivets sharply cut from Tidestone. Underwater, the rivets blend with the surrounding hues, yet glimmer softly like fish scales when touched by light.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalFalchio: A falchion forged from sharply honed Tidestone. Its weight remains substantial, yet it moves more smoothly underwater. The broad teal blade shimmers with an iridescent glow whenever it catches the light.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalJesterC: A whimsical jester’s cap. The Tidestone beads at the tips of its horns shimmer with a gentle light even beneath the water.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalKrisDag: A kris dagger forged from refined Tidestone. The pale teal blade bears the stone’s distinctive wave patterns and its color lightens underwater making it hard to notice.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalLightGa: Gauntlets crafted from a lightweight alloy infused with Tidestone. Designed for effortless movement even underwater.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalOcculti: Boots finished with a coating of Tidestone powder over sturdy fabric. With each step, a faint teal glow shimmers across their surface, evoking a sense of quiet mystique.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalPlateBo: Boots forged from refined Tidestone. Their weight allows steady movement underwater, though they offer little speed.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalPlatePa: These plate leggings forged from Tidestone possess formidable defense equal to their heavy weight and allow somewhat smoother movement underwater.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalProwler: Leather gloves treated with Tidestone powder. They are less affected by water currents, allowing agile and precise movement even underwater.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalRegalGa: This garment enhanced with Tidestone powder offers a comfortable fit along with excellent water resistance and keeps the wearer comfortable even when wet.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalScaledA: This armor made from thinly forged Tidestone scales possesses sturdy defense and allows natural movement even in rough currents.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalSleekHi: Leather pants polished with Tidestone powder. They bear a teal sheen and resist discoloration even when wet.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalSpangen: A helmet crafted from layered plates forged out of refined Tidestone ingots. Faint traces of wave-like patterns remain upon its surface.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalSturdyB: Boots enhanced with Tidestone powder for slight water resistance. The thick lining offers protection but adds extra weight.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalTimewor: This robe is adorned with turquoise patterns embroidered in Tidestone threads. It is sturdily crafted to withstand the passage of time without fraying.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalTrunkHo: These pants made with added Tidestone powder dry quickly when wet, and their puffed silhouette naturally restores itself, providing a consistently fresh and comfortable wear.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalVisored: Forged from Tidestone, this sallet endures the roughest currents, steadfastly shielding the wearer’s head.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidalWandere: This worn outfit, enhanced with Tidestone powder, possesses a slight degree of water resistance.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidestoneIng: A highly enriched ingot of pure Tidestone.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidestoneOre: A dirty chunk of rock bearing traces of Tidestone with teal wave-like patterns.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidestonePow: Powder made by finely grinding Tidestone ore.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TidewalkerFi: A fin taken from a Tidewalker’s back. Remarkably tough for its thickness, it minimizes resistance in the water, allowing swift and agile movement.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TimewornRobe: Designed to be lightweight yet resilient, grants freedom of movement and adorned with intricate patterns.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TokenOfHonor: A medal awarded to the courageous warriors who have demonstrated exceptional bravery in battle.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TomeofSheol_: Bound from ash of the damned and inked in demon blood, this unholy tome whispers the vile language of eternal torment.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TongueOfMimi: A grotesque and slimy elongated tongue, taken from the maw of a mimic.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Topfhelm_000: Crafted with an unconventional shape allowing for optimal ventilation, preventing overheating during intense combat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Torch_0001: A wooden stick wrapped in a flammable substance, capable of illuminating the dark.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TornBatWing: A lightweight leathery wing, it appears to be torn.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TornSail: A sail damaged by long voyages and raging storms. Its color has faded, and holes are scattered across its surface.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TracingWheel: A tailoring tool used to mark even dots on fabric or leather, guiding the cutting or sewing line.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TrapDisarmin: A compact kit filled with an assortment of finely crafted specialized tools that make disarming even the most complex traps seem like child's play.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TrapperHat_0: A hunter’s hat made of thick leather. With ear flaps for warmth, it protects the head during long hours outdoors.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TriPeltDoubl: Crafted using a combination of pelts that bridges the gap between the cunning predator and a hardy brute.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TriPeltNorth: Crafted from a menagerie of leathers, this tunic features pelts from creatures both mundane and rare.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Tripod: A metal stand with three legs, used to hold small cauldrons or pots over a fire.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TrollBane_50: The blood soaked wood from the mighty Troll’s club whittled down to a manageable size and weight.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TrollBlood_5: Blood essence obtained from a Cave Troll, you will gain extraordinary healing capabilities with this!
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TrollPelt: A massive thick pelt with an unmistakable scent.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TrollsClub: A massive and crudely carved club, its weight and rough edges make it a devastating weapon in close-quarters combat.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TroubadourOu: A stylish outfit that storytellers would love to wear.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_TrunkHose_00: Hose padded at the thighs to create volume. Below the calves, they fit tightly to the legs without hindering movement.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Turnshoe_000: Made from quality bovine hide and firm stitching. Named due to it being crafted inside out.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Twig: A small branch with decent length and flexibility.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ValentineCan: Say “I love you!” with every bite of these delicious sweet treats. Hard candy hearts with messages of endearment.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_ValiantAttir: An attire of fine silk, lavishly embroidered with intricate patterns, seamlessly joined with a polished leather vest that accentuates the wearer’s dignity.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_VigilantCloa: The vibrant blue of the cloak is believed to be the result of an ancient dyeing technique that involves sapphire crystals, worn by those of prestige.
The vibrant blue of the cloak is believed to be the result of an ancient dyeing technique that involves sapphire crystals, worn by those of prestige.
The vibrant blue of the cloak is believed to be the result of an ancient dyeing technique that involves sapphire crystals, worn by those of prestige.

DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_VikingHelm_0: A reliable iron helmet that transitions to thick leather pieces, overlaid with tightly knit chainmail.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_VikingSword_: This expertly crafted Viking sword features a sharp blade and sturdy hilt.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_VisoredBarbu: The inside of this intimidating helm is lined with a soft padding to help protect against head focused attacks.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_VisoredSalle: With its sturdy construction and broad brim, this helm ensures your head remains safe in the heat of battle.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_VoidBlade_50: Crafted of dark matter and ironstone, a blade beyond earthly limitations.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_VolcanicAsh: A residue left behind by granules of volcanic ash.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WalkingCane: An old walking cane once used by a noble. The handle is adorned with a dragon's head.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WandererAtti: Old clothes worn out in a long wandering life.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WanderlightL: In a prosperous era, Toz, the loyal court wizard of the king, created these lanterns. Harnessing his growing powers, he equipped the elite guard with these beacons, aiming to protect against dangers that would otherwise remain unseen.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WantedPoster: A wanted poster bearing someone's face and name. It's stained and torn in places, but the details remain legible.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WarHammer_00: Sturdy metal head with three differently shaped protrusions all useful, fastened to a sturdy wooden shaft.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WarHorn: A war horn carved from the hollowed horn of a bull. When blown, it produces a heavy sound that bolsters the morale of allies and strikes fear into the enemy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WarMaul_0001: Only the sturdiest wooden hilt could sustain the giant metal slab on top. The weight of this maul can be felt in every swing.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WarMaul_8001: A War Maul reinforced with the hardened hide of a ferocious beast. With a single swing, it can alter the course of currents and summon a torrent of crashing waters.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WardenOutfit: Crafted with extra layers of hardened leather, supplying body and neck protection.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Wardweed_100: It is believed that this herb only grows in soil once scorched by the searing heat of a dragon's breath.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WarlordsArmo: A shard from the legendary Warlord's battle-worn armor, a relic echoing ancient conflicts. Each fragment bears the weight of innumerable battles.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WarlordsBrok: The legendary Warlord's riven weapon, shattered in the crucible of battle. A silent testament to the unwavering determination of its former master.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WatchmanCloa: This forest green cloak is often the preferred choice of those who wish to blend seamlessly with nature.
This forest green cloak is often the preferred choice of those who wish to blend seamlessly with nature.
This forest green cloak is often the preferred choice of those who wish to blend seamlessly with nature.
This forest green cloak is often the preferred choice of those who wish to blend seamlessly with nature.

This forest green cloak is often the preferred choice of those who wish to blend seamlessly with nature.
This forest green cloak is often the preferred choice of those who wish to blend seamlessly with nature.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WendigoHoof: These are the hooves of a sturdy Wendigo as he trod the cold earth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WendigoSharp: These are the nails of Wendigo, who has slaughtered countless creatures, tearing their flesh apart.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WendigosAntl: Wendigo's grotesquely overgrown horns bear the dried blood of countless victims.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WendigosEntr: Wendigo's guts, grotesquely exposed outside his body, reek of decay, deterioration, death, and contamination.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WhiteSash: A pristine white sash, radiating an air of elegance and purity.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WhiteSharkFi: The dorsal fin of the great white shark, known as the outlaw of the sea. Thick and tough in texture, it is regarded among gourmets as a rare delicacy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WhiteSharkHi: The dorsal hide of a great white shark, surprisingly smooth and soft despite its ferocious owner. Its surface still holds traces of seawater, giving it a faint, lingering dampness.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WhiteSharkTo: A razor-sharp tooth made for rending flesh, its surface still crusted with the flesh and fresh blood of a recently bitten prey.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WhiteThreadS: A bundle of white thread neatly wound around a wooden spool.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WindLocket_3: Silver pendant necklace inlaid with filigree surrounding a mystical blue stone.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WindlassCros: Crafted with added metal around it's wooden bend for a more stable shot, requiring a bit of effort to reload.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WizardHat_00: “The taller the wizard hat the more superior the wizard.” - Wizard in the Sky.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WizardShoes_: Crafted using some the softest leathers to accommodate the delicate feet.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WizardStaff_: A staff carefully crafted with spiraling branches from a magical tree that encase an enchanted orb.
Rumored to be crafted by a powerful yet mischievous trickster from another realm, who delighted in confusing and outsmarting their enemies.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WolfClaw: The razor-sharp talon of a vanquished Dire Wolf.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WolfFang: A gleaming fang torn from the jaws of a Dire Wolf.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WolfHunterLe: Heavy Leather Leggings using the pelts acquired from powerful beasts.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WolfPelt: A robust hide that is covered in thick coarse fur.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WoodenDice: A crudely carved wooden die. Its surface has been worn smooth by countless hands.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WoodenFiguri: A small wooden figurine roughly carved by hand. The sculptor's unskilled but earnest touch still lingers.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WoodenMask: A grotesquely warped mask, its surface crusted with patches of an unknown dried substance.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WoodenPlank: A wooden plank cut into a neat rectangular shape.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WoodenStake: A wooden stake with a sharpened tip.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WoodsmanAxe_: A common iron axe capable of chopping down most trees.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WoolenCap_00: A practical cap easily found by anyone. Knitted from wool, it is not thick but offers minimal warmth.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_WovenRattanB: A small decorative bottle woven from rattan. The surface retains the natural texture of the plant.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_YellowThread: A bundle of yellow thread neatly wound around a wooden spool.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Zweihander_0: The sheer weight and length of this mighty double-edge blade can be felt pulling on you as you swing.
DC.Text_DesignData_Item_Flavor_Zweihander_8: This massive sword was tempered in uncountable rivers of blood. Still insatiable, it drives its wielder to crave more until their final breath.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbyEmote_LobbyEmote_Fl: Drive your head into the table expressing your frustration with the current situation.
Treat your senses to the rich, tantalizing taste of coffee.
Nothing marks a special occasion quite like a cake. Beyond its layers of delicate flavors, this cake represents our collective adventures, each bite enriched with memories of camaraderie.
Accept your loss, gracefully bowing out of the battle.

With brightly burning sparkler candles and a two-tiered cake, we celebrate the time we've shared together. As we look back on the adventures so far and look forward to the journey ahead, let’s enjoy this moist and crunchy crumble cake together.
Put on a fine monocle and appraise the authenticity of your newly found treasure. The more you examine, the keener your eye for valuable treasures shall become.

With a steady hand and a heart full of purpose, the scribe’s quill dances across the page. Their words serve as the compass by which others navigate, offering guidance, clarity, and the truth of ages.
Think carefully before placing your next card. A single careless move could cost you everything.

When you whistle, a storm petrel swoops down and perches briefly on your shoulder. These windborne creatures are rarely tamed. This one responds only to your call, ever since you saved its life as a dying chick.
Harness the universal language of approval.
The hunger is real, energetically express your craving for sustenance.
Yield to the overwhelming urge to doze after what feels like an eternity awaiting your overdue companions.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Cap: The captain's cabin of a pirate ship wrecked by a raging storm. Beyond the half-shattered deck, an endless sea crashes with terrifying force. No matter how infamous a pirate may be, they are powerless before the stormy sea. Lose your way here, and all will vanish beneath the waves.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Def: The original gathering place for adventurers ready to delve into the dungeons.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Emb: A Dwarven hall long cut off from the outside world. Though much of it has collapsed and been engulfed in lava, it still retains its imposing grandeur.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Exq: A treasury overflowing with unimaginable riches, its contents are meant for the eyes of nobility alone, as even the most humble of servants can be consumed by its greed.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Hal: Beware, brave soul, for you've wandered into a lobby where the eerie and earthly collide. Cobwebs cling to the décor while the warm glow of jack-o'-lanterns flickers with mischief, and an array of spooky companions join you in the festive frights, surrounding you with the spirit of All Hallows' Eve.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Hol: The halls are dressed in festive finery, where glittering ornaments hang like promises of hope in a realm ruled by shadows.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Sub: Beneath the sunlit surface lies a tranquil underwater cave. As you watch the aquatic creatures swim freely, a deep sense of calm gently settles within you.
DC.Text_DesignData_LobbySkin_FlavorText_Win: The Ruins Camp, once filled with clashing steel, has found its quiet again beneath the falling snow. Enjoy this brief stillness while it lasts.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownAurora: The path down to the icy abyss. Wait for the aura to glow red from dark below before taking your leap of faith to the unknown.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownCrackPit: A rift that opens with a red glow after a certain amount of time. It allows descent into the deeper dungeons.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownElevator: An elevator that drops down in regular intervals to help brave adventurers delve deeper into the dungeons.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownPortalDu: A double red portal that appears randomly in the dungeons allowing up to two adventurers to delve deeper into the dungeons for a chance at better loot.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownPortalSo: A single red portal that appears randomly in the dungeons allowing an adventurer to delve deeper into the dungeons for a chance at better loot. The portal can be used by one person only.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownPortalTr: A triple red portal that appears randomly in the dungeons allowing up to three adventurers to delve deeper into the dungeons for a chance at better loot.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownStair: Magical stairways that allow adventurers to delve deeper into the dungeons. When the torches next to the stairways begin to glow red, the magical stairways can be accessed to descend deeper into the dungeons.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_DownUpcoming: When the time is right, a pathway to the deep unknown is revealed at this mysterious location.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeAnchor: Passing ships will make stops at these anchor points to welcome aboard any adventurers looking for passage out of the cursed waters.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeCrackP: A rift that opens with a blue glow after a certain amount of time. It allows escape from the dungeon.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeDrawbr: A large heavy drawbridge guards the cursed grounds. When the torches next to the drawbridge tower begin to glow blue, access the wheel inside to slowly lower the drawbridge for a path to safety.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeElevat: An escape elevator designed to help desperate adventurers escape.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeExtern: An awaiting ship ready to rescue abandoned adventurers on the open seas. You must take a rowboat out to the ship for a chance to be hauled up. Blue torches on the ship’s pulley mechanism start to glow blue when it is ready to hoist up survivors. Be sure to position your rowboat properly so the hoisting ropes can properly hook your rowboat.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapePortal: A double escape portal that appears randomly in the dungeons allowing up to two adventurers to escape the dungeons.

A single escape portal that appears randomly in the dungeons allowing an adventurer to escape with their riches. Once this portal is activated, it can only be used by a single adventurer to escape from the dungeons.

A triple escape portal that appears in the dungeons, allowing up to three adventurers to escape. Watch closely for traces of a faint blue glow. If no such signs remain, it may already have been claimed by others.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeRaft: A lonely raft that spawns at regular intervals allowing weary adventurers to escape the caverns through the internal river networks.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeRope: A rope that descends from above after a certain amount of time. It allows escape from the dungeon and can be used by one person only.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_EscapeStair: Magical stairways that allow adventurers to escape from the dungeon. When the torches beside the stairways glow blue, the sealed gate opens, allowing escape to a safe location. The gate will close after a short time but can be reopened. While open, the stairways can be used without restriction.
DC.Text_DesignData_MapIconDesc_Resurrection: A Sacrificial Altar that is used to resurrect a fallen ally. The altar requires a party member’s Soul Heart to bring them back from the dead. The altar can only be used a single time.
DC.Text_DesignData_Merchant_Merchant_Mercha: Why don't you try out one of my concoctions. It's a blast!
Welcome, in search of armor? You've come to the right place. Here, we focus on strength and durability. Let's get you fitted for the journey ahead.

...
(A nest clumsily woven from twigs, feathers, and the like. Though small, it looks warm and cozy. Since a cockatrice hatched by hand is said to bring its master treasures, it would be wise to raise it with care and affection.)

...!?
(Within the nest, the deep violet egg rests in a cozy manner, at times appearing to shudder ever so slightly as though stirred by an unseen breeze.)

Peep! Peep-peep! Peep!
(A diminutive cockatrice hatchling chirps in a high, delicate tone as it gazes upon thee with a look of mirthful welcome. Though its downy, snowy plumage renders it seemingly harmless, its beak and claws are already keen and resolute.)

Grrrr...
(A youthful cockatrice methodically preens its freshly grown, deep blue feathers. As thou dost draw near, it raises its head and regards thee with a calm, measured gaze.)

Kyaaa! Kiaaaa! Kiooo!
(The fully matured cockatrice fixes its steady eyes upon thee, its long tail swaying with graceful pride. With a regal toss of its head, as if to display its scarlet crest, it proclaims its majestic presence.)
Welcome, adventurer. Do you seek something new? To quench the thirst for a special experience, one must find a different way. The choice is yours.
Adventurer! Good to see you in one piece. Rest assured, your treasures are safe with me. How can I be of service?
I am the conduit between the realms, offering to weave increased fortune into the tapestry of your fates.
Games! Oooh I love playing games! Let’s play a simple one you clever human. You pay me gold and I give you whatever I want. Sounds absolutely delightful!
I can socket a gem to overwrite its power onto your enhanced gear. The rarity of the gem must match the rarity of your gear. Please note that this process is irreversible!
Looking for a tougher challenge? If you’re not afraid of danger, I’ve got more than enough work for you.

Here we go. Let’s begin this winter’s festival. Forget kind old Nicholas. This year, it’s just me. If you don’t do something, you won’t gain anything. So go on. Head out and do what you call a “good deed.”
Welcome, traveler. Looking for quality leather gear? Each piece is crafted with care. Perhaps you'll find something that suits your adventures.
Adventurer, I need your help. My homeland has been consumed by fires beyond our control. Please save my kin, who are bound to that place.
Not many know the waters near the Blue Maelstrom as well as I do. It's not a place one forgets.
Ho Ho Ho, Adventurer! You may not know me but I know you. My friend here Mookia, the winter Strix, has a sweet tooth. Bring me back candy canes and I will exchange gifts. Be swift!
I am... one who has lost all memory... My name... my past... all forgotten... Still... would you listen to my story...?
Oh my head, that's a long story. By the way, I'd be looking for some nice treats. Lil bits of orange, yellow, and white. Makes a nice match with my noggin. I promise I won't trick ya.

Ah, if it isn't my favorite adventurer... Quite a change of scenery from the dungeons, isn't it? Fresh air at last, and just in time for the Anniversary celebration. The powers that be have scattered special tokens throughout the lands. Collect them and exchange them for some festive delights!

Select the items you want to as your base gear. I’ll have your base gear ready whenever you need to quickly enter a dungeon. Please be sure to ‘set’ your base gear if you make any changes to your kit.​
Your health is my concern.
Come take a look at my exquisite works!
Welcome to the Tavern. Here, we have good ale and sturdy chairs. Make yourself at home, just don't cause any trouble.
I'll pay you top price for any unique trinkets you can bring back from below.
Gold and silver is my language. How may I help you with your financial needs?
Greetings, adventurer. If you have a moment, would you care to discuss the love that weaves through the fabric of this world?
So many adventurers, so little time. I need to bust out these weapons as fast as I can.
If you intend to survive below, you've come to the right person.
DC.Text_DesignData_Merchant_StockBuy_Conver: Ah, an excellent selection! It will undoubtedly prove useful in your future endeavors.
I am not the only one who can offer such experiences. Yet these rare and precious items will be difficult to obtain without me. Now then, have a look around.
Behold, the goods you've decided upon shall turn the tides of fortune in your favor.
Yes, yes come buy my trinkets. Very fair, I would never trick you human. Just take my word for it, no need to check... Heheh
Those who prove themselves deserve a reward to match. It’s your gift, so choose it yourself.
Lot's of hard work went into crafting that leatherwork.
Oh I think it's about to snow!
What you need... might be here... Take your time... and look around...
Ooh I can hardly wait to get my hands on those sweet little bites.
Well, well, what do we have here? Celebration tokens! Bring them here, and I'll see what goodies I can conjure for you.
Hopefully you won't need to use these on your adventures.
My needlework is the best there is!
Hopefully it won't give you a hangover.
This brew took a bit of craftsmanship. I highly recommend it!
These items have all been blessed by me in hopes of spreading love and love can be expressed in many ways...
Had to smith these out as fast as I could...
That will definitely increase your odds of survival.
DC.Text_DesignData_Merchant_StockBuy_SaleCo: Now don't go mixing my potions, you never know what will happen!
You possess a most discerning eye. This item will shine in your hands. Savor the outcome of your choice to the fullest.
May the stars align during your adventures.
A deal well struck! Gratitude, human.
Do you like it? Gifts are better when you choose them yourself, rather than having them handed to you.
I stand by my work, but no refunds!
I hope... that item... will be of help to you...
Just like I said. I'm a master of treats, not the trickster everyone makes me out to be.

Enjoy your well-earned spoils, but beware of shadow-dwellers always lurking and waiting to snatch away your possessions. However, losing one's belongings to those cursed mummy spiders is far worse! Those pesky little beasts can be quite the nuisance.
If you get sick don't blame me.
Thank you. I will not forget your efforts. May your path ahead be filled with love!
It'll do the trick but don't expect too much.
DC.Text_DesignData_Merchant_StockCraft_Conv: Bring me some Cobalt ore and I'll happily transform it into a useful powder for a price.
Provide me with the ore, and I'll produce a copper powder that's as fine as it is useful. You won't be disappointed.
The art of transformation is my domain. What shall I brew for you?
Oh, what do we have here... Shall we capture the icy essence of the Frost Mountain in it's finest form?
Ah, your intrigues are never less than opulent. Bring me gold ore and I will gladly transform it into gold powder for you.
Need Iron powder? Just provide the ore, and I'll transform it into powder as fine as any you've seen. Remember, quality comes at a price.
If you bring me obsidian ore, I can reduce it to a fine, high-quality powder at a modest cost.
Bring me some Rubysilver ore and I'll happily transform it into a useful powder form for a price.
Silver in your hands? Let's turn it into powder. The process is delicate, but the result is a wonderfully versatile product.
Bring me some Tidestone ore and I'll happily transform it into a useful powder form for a price.
Gather me some cobalt ingots and I will Smelt, shape and craft you the most amazing wears.
Gather up those Copper ingots and bring them here. I'll put my skills to work and create Copper wares that are useful.
Welcome, adventurer! If you need something, just let me know. I may not look it, but I’m pretty good at what I do.
Advance and witness the might of Froststone. Deliver your ore, and I will fashion armor as impervious as the eternal ice.
With your Gold ingots, I will forge wares that weave luxury into every detail.
How about I make you a brilliant crimson piece of armor!
Bring me some Tidestone, and I’ll make you an armor so light you’ll move through the water like it’s air.
There is a familiar face! Supply me with some Cobalt ore and I will quickly turn them into pure Cobalt ingots.
In need of refined Copper? Provide me with the ore, and I'll smelt and craft it into high-quality copper ingots. Let's get started.
You wish to meld ice and stone into something extraordinary? Even the improbable is possible in my seasoned hands.
Supply me with gold ore and with skilled hands, I will smelt you pure gold ingots, traveler.
Welcome, Adventurer. Crafting fine jewelry and accessories is my specialty. If there is a design you have in mind, please feel free to tell me.
Welcome back! If you have Iron ore, I can work my magic and turn it into top-quality Iron ingots. Just leave it to me.
Provide me with some Cobalt powder and I can produce a masterpiece I tell you!
Supply me with the materials and I'll craft them into Copper wares that are a perfect blend of practicality and durability.
The scent of leather mingles with creativity. What creation shall emerge today?
Seeking protection with a touch of frost? Provide your Froststone, and I'll incorporate its essence into sturdy leather gear.
Gather your gold materials and bring them to me. I’ll shape and craft them into glorious gold wares.
Bring me some Rubysilver powder and I can create magic I tell you!
Please, bring me some Tidestone. I’ll see to it that the leather keeps its color, no matter how long it stays in the water.
Did you bring obsidian ore? If you hand it over to me, I’ll refine it into a high-quality obsidian ingot by removing the impurities.
It always amazes me that you can extract such a magical metal from such ugly stone.
Welcome! Bring me your silver coins or ore and I'll work them into pristine ingots.
You’re lucky I’m even available to make you some enhanced Cobalt outfits.
Should your copper materials be of a quality that meets my standards, I will consider fashioning it into apparel that's the very definition of excellence.
You should consider yourself fortunate I have time to craft you some superior items today.

You're in luck today. You've brought Froststone, a material worthy of my talents. Let's shape it into a garment that not only meets but exceeds the ordinary—crafted, of course, to my exacting standards.
Hand over your golden materials and watch as I craft them into exquisite golden wearable treasures, worthy of kings and queens.
Ugh, If you really need it I guess I can make you some enhanced Rubysilver outfits.
Would you bring me some Tidestone? With my exceptional skill, I’ll craft something truly to your taste.
In need of refined Tidestone? Bring me the raw ore, and I will forge it into high-quality Tidestone ingots.
For a reasonable fee, I shall assemble an impactful weapon.
Ah, you've ventured into the cold? Supply Froststone, and I'll create weapons as piercing and cold as the frostbite wind.
Working with gold always brings a smile to my face.
Good to see you. Iron is a reliable choice. Let me turn it into weapons that are both practical and sturdy.

DC.Text_DesignData_NameplateSkin_FlavorText: It is the mark of those who once ruled the seas. Survivors of countless storms, they are ready to do whatever it takes to reclaim their former glory.
A no frills nameplate for all adventurers.
Deep beneath the mountains, the Land of Fire roils with ferocity. Yet neither the suffocating heat nor the surging lava can bar your path.
Are you fond of Otto? Let the world see your heart for this sweet and charming pup, wear your love with pride!
Your insatiable curiosity for the Ruins knows no bounds. As if under a spell, you find yourself drawn again and again to these forsaken places.
Even as fierce storms rage and angry waves block the way, you press on. The perilous voyage is far from over.
Behind the splendor of glory, the shadow of death is always cast. To achieve a true feat, one must endure the darkness that lurks behind beauty.
Eyes hollow, bones splintered, yet they march—a procession of anguish bound by eternal war.
Even on a snowy winter night, the undying light of the castle quietly calls to you. You are not the only one drawn to its glow, making your way toward the ruins.

DC.Text_DesignData_PlayerCharacter_PlayerCh: The Barbarian is known for his hardy nature, fiery temper, and ability to endure immense pain. His rage and reckless abandon allow him to lead the charge into battle.

The Bard is a weaver of moving melodies and fantastic tales. They manage to get out of the stickiest of situations using their uncanny ability to mysteriously control the mood of crowds and creatures.
The Cleric is a soldier of immense faith. The Cleric uses his sacred bonds to his gods to call forth the protective powers of light and to vanquish the forces of dark.
The Druid is a spirit mage with a deep connection to nature. Able to wield the powers of the wilderness, they can even transform their bodies to mimic the powers of beasts.
The Fighter is a jack of all trades when it comes to combat. Well-versed with a multitude of weapons and armaments, the Fighter can hold his own against anyone.
The Ranger is an excellent survivalist. With a keen eye and quick hands, the Ranger tracks his enemies, sets traps and ambushes unsuspecting prey.
The Rogue is a master of deception able to silently slip between the shadows to work his dastardly deeds. His dexterous hands enable him to quickly loot riches, pick locks, and disable various traps.
The Sorcerer is a master of the elements and can weave together multiple spells to devastating results. With an innate aptitude for magic, they can cast spells using their bare hands.
The Warlock is a brooding manipulator of dark magic. They sacrifice their life force to call upon unknown forces of pain and evil. A worthy adversary proficient in both magic and weapons.

The Wizard calls forth the immense powers of magic to suit his needs. Whether that means summoning a powerful fireball to cast asunder his foes or to temporarily vanishing into thin air, his incantations are a sight to behold.

DC.Text_DesignData_Quest_Alchemist_Complete: Good. This is only the beginning, but it’s a step in the right direction. My brother’s methods are futile, bound by the limitations of the past. Alchemy has no such boundaries. I can feel it working already. The potions, the combinations—each one brings us closer to something greater. He may not see it now, but I will show him the power we could wield if he just opened his eyes.

Excellent. What you’ve uncovered is fascinating. The Kobolds are far more than just beasts—they’re carriers of hidden potential. This reminds me of another experiment I need to conduct. Visit me when you have the time.

Impressive. You’ve uncovered more than I anticipated. The wolves were indeed guarding something of great value, something that could aid my studies. As I suspected, there’s more to this world than science can explain. You've done well, but we're not finished. I’ll need time to study what you found—come back when I’ve made some progress.
It seems the rumor was not mere nonsense after all. A sanctuary that can call back and awaken lost souls... how fascinating. I must conduct further study on that place.
That was quick! I hope it wasn’t too much trouble for you. Now, it’s time to cook!
Excellent! Don’t bother telling me where you found all of these... Here, take these for your trouble.
You really did it, and lived to tell the tale! Although... That didn’t turn out quite how I expected.
Not bad... once you kill enough of those flying filth it starts getting easier and easier.
Thanks for taking care of that mess for me... I was beginning to think I might have gone too far with that last experiment. Here, these should cover any trouble I caused you.

So the rumors were true! A hidden lever—how fascinating. The ruins still hold many secrets beyond our understanding. Ah, and thank you for dealing with the worms. Those wretched creatures are of no benefit to our lives—especially the larger ones!

As expected, it seems to possess a certain degree of resistance to fire. It is too early to draw a definitive conclusion, but further experimentation should make it clear. This should be sufficient to create a potion that prevents burns.
Well done! With those spider pots destroyed, my alchemical experiments are back on track. Now I can work without the fear of toxins creeping into my concoctions.

The heat is remarkable. Mishandled it could easily cause burns. Hm, what if an explosive property were added to it. Smaller than a firebomb, yet far more powerful. It would certainly be worth researching.
In the damp recesses of this place, you've emerged victorious once more. Keep your spirit ablaze, for greater challenges lie ahead.

Well done. In alchemy, the temperature of fire is just as important. Maintaining a stable temperature over a long period is especially difficult. Thanks to these embers, future experiments should proceed much more smoothly. Thank you.
Thank you for your efforts. The underworld is dreadful, but it is also a place where we can find things of great value. That is why we must continue our exploration.
I have always known of your skill, but seeing you return unharmed is still a relief. Now that the demon of the Inferno has fallen, let us continue our expedition into the deeper depths.

A triumph beyond measure! The king’s soul is finally at peace, and I could feel the air itself grow lighter. You’ve accomplished more than I could ever repay, but I hope this reward brings you some measure of gratitude.
DC.Text_DesignData_Quest_Alchemist_Greeting: You know, my brother, the Surgeon, has never forgiven me for abandoning traditional medicine. He still believes in the old ways, as if stitching up the body can heal the soul—curses, for example. I learned that lesson too late. Our mother died in agony, and I was powerless to help. That’s when alchemy called to me—its promise of real power, of true healing. I need these potions, not just for myself, but to show him the way forward. He’ll see the truth eventually... even if I have to make him understand the hard way.

I’ve always been intrigued by the Ice Kobolds. Their adaptability, their strange tenacity... it’s more than mere survival—it’s something we can learn from. Their biology, their resistance to the cold, could unlock new alchemical properties. What I need from you is to search their territory—there may be something in their environment, or even within their own flesh, we can use. Their blood, their marrow, perhaps even their mucus.

You’ve heard of the Frost Wolves, no doubt. The rumors say they’re guarding something precious, but I believe there’s more to it. My work with potions and alchemy has taught me that nothing is ever as simple as it seems. These wolves are just another puzzle to solve. I need you to investigate what they’re keeping from us. If there’s something powerful hidden away, it could hold the answers to many questions... perhaps even questions I never wanted to ask.
According to rumor, deep within the Forgotten Castle lies a chapel said to summon the dead... Could you seek it out for me?
Here, take this list and fetch me these ingredients right away! There might be something to that book you brought me... and there’s only one way to find out.
I never thought much of old texts... but the power in that last recipe was undeniable. This next one is a little grim, but I think you can handle it.
Have you ever thought about what might happen if you used four different potions at the same time?! Well, I need you to find out! And, well... try to survive.
Flying skulls of the dead have infested parts of The Forgotten Castle... I need you to get rid of as many as you can... but you only have one shot.

It seems my experiments have not gone unnoticed... Wraiths have risen, surrounded by animated skeletons. The longer we wait, the larger the undead horde will become... I need you to get rid of as many as you can. Please, hurry before this spirals out of control!

There are rumors that some of the statues among the ruins can be manipulated. I would be grateful if you could investigate the secrets hidden within them. And while you're at it, could you also deal with the giant worms? Those disgusting creatures devour everything in their path—including my alchemical ingredients.

A place long hidden has finally revealed itself. This is truly delightful news. In lands where lava boils, rare creatures dwell that are seldom encountered. Each of them is worthy of experimentation, making it difficult to decide where to begin. Hm. For now, the shells of lava turtles will do nicely.

Ah, there you are! The Ruins are infested with eight-legged artisans. Time to make a mess of their nests, because their venom has been seeping into my alchemical ingredients, contaminating everything I work with. I need those pots destroyed before their poison spoils another batch of my precious brews!

To most adventurers, slimes are little more than a nuisance, but from an alchemical perspective they are excellent resources. Not a single part of their bodies goes to waste. Depending on their innate nature they produce various essences, which is especially useful. A lava slime should contain an essence of fire, so bring me a few.
Here, amidst the darkness and chaos, your mettle will be tested as you strive to survive against the odds. During your journey do what you can to rid the area of any Skeletons in your path!

Spirits only manifest in places saturated with primal power. The appearance of a fire spirit is proof that the Firedeep is filled with intense heat. This is very good news for us. There is a pure ember that can be obtained from a fire spirit. It is small, but it does not fade for a very long time, so please retrieve some for me.

Many adventurers struggle to navigate the exact paths of the Inferno. The landscape constantly shifts, throwing travelers into confusion. If you could map out the paths of the Inferno, it would be of great help.
Great demons are obstructing my descent into the Inferno. Deal with them, if you must. All at once. That way, the path might stay safe for a while. Keep that in mind. It's important.

Echoes have been heard deep below The Forgotten Castle... I dare not believe it, but it may be the ghost of the long-lost king. Freeing his soul could finally break the demonic curse that has plagued the castle for generations.
DC.Text_DesignData_Quest_Armourer_Complete_: Impressive. This metal is just the start. The armor I’ll craft with it will be something worth relying on. It's not just about the steel—it's about what it represents. It’s strength, it’s survival... it’s knowing what this world can do, and preparing for it.

My wife was tortured, branded like livestock, forced into rituals that I can hardly describe. They cut her, bled her, and left her for dead. When I found her, she was a shell—her body marked with symbols, her soul broken. I thought I could save her, but I’m not sure anymore. The woman I married is gone, replaced by someone who looks like her, but isn’t. If you can help, maybe... just maybe, I’ll get her back.

This is a solid start, but we’re not prepared yet. There’s more to be done, and time isn’t on our side. Come back later. I’ve got to consult with the brothers and see if they’ve discovered anything that might give us an edge.
Yeah... this is the stuff... I’ll see what I can do with this, but for now I need your help with a another matter.

You brought it back! I've never seen ore with patterns like this before. I wonder if they'll still remain after it's been smelted. I need to get my hands on this new material. Let’s see how far I can work it.
I hope it wasn’t too dangerous out there... that place is notorious for grave robbers, But if I’d told you that earlier, I doubt you would’ve taken the journey.

Hmm, tough, sharp... and still carrying the full scent of the sea. I can’t use them as they are. I’ll need to wash and dry them properly first. Still, I think I can make a decent piece of armor out of these.
I know it wasn’t easy... but take this for your effort. It should be much easier to get inside the castle now.

I’m glad to see you’ve returned in one piece. It’s people like you that give meaning to the work I do. It makes me happy to know I was able to help, even just a little. I’ll keep working to craft even sturdier armor from here on.
I’m glad you checked out the area. Although I’m still skeptical about that fortune teller’s cryptic message, it seems like there might be something to it after all.
You provided us with a moment's respite from the evil’s reign on these lands... Thank you adventurer.
These samples are even more vile than I imagined... but they should be enough to trace the origin of this plague. If I uncover anything further, you’ll be the first to know.

Thank you. At a glance these may seem to have nothing to do with making armor, but they are crafted with remarkably fine and complex techniques. Examining them piece by piece will be good study for me.

Was there nothing unusual? Ah, I see... No, never mind. It would be absurd for me to demand more from you when I haven’t even set foot there myself. Still, thanks to you dismantling so many traps, others will have an easier time exploring the Crypts for a while. Thank you.

Well done. Of course, I never expected to uncover the Crypts’ problems in a single attempt. If that were possible, the cause of this plague would have been solved long ago. Yet, I still can’t shake the thought that the tomb itself is the source of the disease. Further investigation will be necessary.

Good heavens, these pieces are absolutely brilliant. The finish, especially, so fine and precise. Not a rough edge in sight, and the seams... you'd hardly know where one piece ends and another begins unless you’re squinting at it. This is going to be a real lesson for me. Thank you, truly.

You went and checked that many torches? I can't thank you enough for going above and beyond. Knowing you looked into it so thoroughly puts my mind at ease. Seems that strange little rumor really was just nonsense after all. Ha, I mean honestly, torches lighting themselves? What a thought!

Did the shrine’s blessing serve you well? Funny thing is, even folks who don’t give much thought to gods and such often start believing once they’ve felt the power of a shrine’s blessing. I’ve heard some people feel a wave of relief just from spotting one. In a dungeon crawling with enemies, having even a moment’s peace like that is no small mercy.
DC.Text_DesignData_Quest_Armourer_Greeting_: The world doesn’t give second chances. Trust me, I’ve seen it take everything from people. Cobalt is a rare metal—used to forge weapons and armor that can help one survive in otherwise dire situations. Too many adventurers and warriors come to me thinking they can rely on luck, and they end up as nothing but wreckage. Bring me the ore, and we’ll craft something with strength that won’t break when everything else does.

I’m dealing with something I wouldn’t wish on my worst enemy. My wife was taken—pulled from me by a dark force that I couldn’t fight. I thought I’d never see her again. But she’s back, though not in the way I’d hoped. Things were done to her—things that should never happen to anyone. I’ve spoken to someone who may have answers, but first, I need to gather certain items, things that might help us help her.

I can’t bear to watch her slip away. I’m gathering a few of my comrades to join me, but I won’t ask them to help without making sure they’re ready. We need armor—armor that will hold up against what’s waiting for us. The clock’s ticking, and I don’t think she has much time left.
Rubysilver Ore... that stuff’s been known to make some of the most durable armor I’ve ever seen... If you fetch me some, I might be able to make you something out of it in the future.

There’s an ore they say can only be found in the Blue Maelstrom. Could you get some for me? It’s a new material, so I’d love to go see it for myself... but I get awful seasickness, you see. So I’ll leave it to you.
All kinds of adventurers have been buried in that old graveyard in the Ruins... Go check it out... you might even find something royal.

I heard the creatures in the Blue Maelstrom have incredibly tough hides. Crab shells that don’t even scratch under a blade, and sea urchin spines sharp enough to pierce metal armor. I suppose that’s only natural, given how harsh the sea is out there. If you don’t mind, could you bring me a few crab shells and urchin spines? I’d like to see if they can be used to reinforce armor.
The Ruins have filled up with animated Slime and Wisps lately... please... can you deal with them before it gets out of hand?

Dangerous places tend to have dangerous monsters. The Tidewalkers may wield crude weapons, but their aggression is no joke. And since they can move between water and land, they’re even more of a threat. If you want to explore the Blue Maelstrom safely, it would be best to clear them out. I can’t go there myself... so please, adventurer. Take care of the Tidewalkers.

Last night, I had a bit too much to drink at the tavern and ended up speaking with the Fortune Teller. She gave me a cryptic message suggesting there might be something worth investigating around this location. I’m not entirely convinced by her mumbo jumbo, but I figured it’s worth a look. See if you can find anything unusual here.

We stand on the brink of our greatest challenge yet, and your courage is needed more than ever. A spectral being wreaks havoc upon the Ruins, leaving destruction in its wake. I believe you are now prepared to face this evil and banish it once and for all.

Some kind of infection is spreading rapidly, turning corpses into unspeakable horrors. If you can hunt down a few of these abominations and bring back some samples, our local surgeon might uncover the source of this plague.

Armor is not meant to be strong alone. Careful finishing is what truly matters. Small differences like that are what make armor last. Too many advanced crafting techniques have been lost, but I hear finely made items from long ago still remain in the Forgotten Castle. Could you bring me a few?

The samples you brought back are covered in wounds. At first, I assumed they were marks of battle, but their consistent placement and size reveal them to be injuries caused by traps. Traps do not distinguish between adventurers and monsters, yet the creatures show no fear of them. Perhaps dismantling those metal constructs could provide some useful insight.

After hearing your report on the traps, a thought crossed my mind. Perhaps it’s not just the traps—we might need to search the Crypts itself more thoroughly. After all, that entire place is nothing but a collection of problems. I don’t have high expectations, but there’s no harm in investigating further.

I heard you fetched some top-quality weapons for the weaponsmith, and what’s he planning to do with them, forge a blade that cuts through everything? Ha, then I can’t just sit back and let him have all the fun. Adventurer, get me some fine armor pieces too, will you? I’ll be the first to craft something that can block anything, yes, anything. Probably. Hopefully. Well... let’s just say I’ll try my best.

There’s a rumor going around about torches in the Forgotten Castle lighting themselves. Good grief, I can understand a flame going out on its own, sure, but lighting itself? That’s just nonsense. The monsters in that place are already more than enough trouble, and now it feels like the castle itself is turning into something out of a nightmare. Could you check on those torches for me? I really, really hope the rumors are just that... rumors.

Shrines in dungeons are a good friend to any adventurer. Before the Forgotten Castle was swallowed by darkness, visitors used to stop and offer their prayers there as part of everyday life. Nowadays, those shrines are lending their strength to adventurers instead. I hope you make good use of their blessings. Sometimes, they can do more for you than even a sturdy piece of armor.

DC.Text_DesignData_Quest_Dealmaker_Greeting: This strange experience will cause you no harm. Like a lucid dream, it will let you see the world from a new perspective. No one will ever know who you truly are, so there is no need to hesitate. Simply pay a trivial price, and savor the sweetest fruit.

DC.Text_DesignData_Quest_FortuneTeller_Comp: Ah, the mimic’s tongue... slick with malice, yet brimming with potential. Its grotesque vitality pulses in my hands—a perfect conduit. Stand close, adventurer, and witness the veil parting. The afflicted bear runes etched into their flesh, their tongues torn from their mouths. They become husks—empty, their will consumed, and soon, they die, as though they were never truly alive. The dead have spoken. Darkness stirs, adventurer—press on, for the truth will demand its due.

Yes... the eye still gleams, its surface slick with gore. The blood of the beast has yet to dry—good. Its essence still thrums with the arcane. But as I gaze into its depths, the vision remains fractured, like shattered glass. The truth hides still, clawing at the edges of perception. Stay close, adventurer—the unknown awaits us.

You’ve done well. The ear still hums with unnatural resonance, as though it drinks in the very silence around us. Already, I feel the faint touch of voices long silenced, brushing against my thoughts. Yet, their message remains indistinct, a riddle without form. The connection must be strengthened, for the dead demand more than mere listening—they will soon seek communion. May the stars align in our favor.

So, the kobolds serve a greater purpose—a chain forged in magic and cruelty. The guardian itself is not merely a creature but a force, bound to keep the curse’s secrets buried in ice. This aligns with what I’ve learned from others, though they, too, only grasp pieces of the puzzle. The altar you unearthed—the one marked with sacrifice—resonates with this guardian’s power. There is but one step left, adventurer, and it is not one to take lightly.
